records.description: Ciphera solves the fundamental Web3 dilemma - How do protocols prevent Sybil attacks and comply with regulations while maintaining the absolute privacy of their users? Users prove they hold a valid government-issued ID and meet specific criteria (e.g., age ≥ 18, Indian citizen) without ever revealing personal data, biometrics, or addresses on-chain or off-chain.

records.name: aitrips.io
records.tagline: Give your AI a place to plan your trips
records.description: Most AI trip advice vanishes when you close the chat. aitrips.io is different, your AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) connects via MCP and saves plans directly to a real web app. - AI creates full itineraries with one conversation - Interactive maps with routes and day-colored markers - Share with travel companions via a single link - Day-by-day views, weather, tasks, budgets, and notes - Works as a standalone planner too - no AI required Free tier available.

records.name: Homeroo
records.tagline: Free rental property management for landlords & investors
records.description: Homeroo is the ultimate tool for real estate investors and landlords. Track rental income, expenses, leases, and net cashflow across all your properties in one place. Monitor maintenance requests, communicate with tenants, and generate financial reports — all completely free. Designed to simplify property management so you can focus on growing your portfolio.

records.name: Plateful: Grocery Lists & Budget Tracker
records.tagline: Smart lists, budget tracking & family sharing in one app.
records.description: Stop guessing what your groceries will cost. Plateful is the only list app with a Universal Store Browser—browse the actual sites of Target, Walmart, or Aldi and one-tap items into your list with live pricing. Why you'll love it: 📍 Smart Sorting: Items are auto-categorized by aisle for faster trips. 💰 Live Budgeting: See your total update in real-time as you shop. 👥 Family Sync: Real-time coordination so nobody forgets the milk. Shop smarter, save more.

records.name: Geekersoft Video Converter
records.tagline: Geekersoft Video Converter is a professional media converter
records.description: Geekersoft Video Converter is a professional, all-in-one media converter built for speed, quality, and simplicity. Powered by upgraded lightning-mode tech, it converts videos & audio 120x faster than standard tools while preserving crisp HD/4K quality. It supports 1000+ formats including MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, MP3, FLAC, AMR, WMA, and advanced codecs like H.265 (HEVC) and VP9.

records.name: Webory
records.tagline: a minimalist writing workspace for ideas and drafts
records.description: I built a writing tool because every writing app felt bloated. So I made something extremely simple: Boards → organize ideas Chapters → write drafts That's it. Curious if other writers prefer simple tools or feature-heavy ones.

records.name: DuplexReady
records.tagline: Fix manual duplex printing in under 60 seconds, free
records.description: Ever printed 20 pages double-sided, flipped them, and got everything out of order? DuplexReady fixes that instantly. Upload your PDF, it auto-detects odd page counts, inserts a blank page if needed, and reorders everything so your manual duplex print comes out perfect — every time. No sign-up. No install. 100% free. Works in your browser in under 60 seconds.

records.name: Klipy — Does the work after every call
records.tagline: Your pipeline has blind spots. Klipy finds them.
records.description: Klipy is your AI sales teammate. It captures every conversation — email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, calls — updates your CRM automatically, drafts follow-ups, and preps your next call. Nothing to log. Nothing to write from scratch. Set up in under 4 minutes.

records.name: IndieAIs
records.tagline: Find the best AI tools built by indie developers.
records.description: Find the best AI tools, agents, and automations built by independent developers. Discover, upvote, and support indie AI. Discover AI agents, tools, and automations from independent builders worldwide.

records.name: BinSizes
records.tagline: Stop guessing if storage bins fit—find by exact dimensions
records.description: BinSizes.com lets you search thousands of storage bins and organizers by exact dimensions — width, depth, and height. Filter to your precise measurements and find bins that actually fit your space, drawer, or shelf. Built for anyone tired of buying the wrong size. Especially useful for professional organizers, IKEA enthusiasts, and anyone doing a serious home organization project. Free, fast, no account needed.

records.name: Explorer
records.tagline: Explore about Notion, AI, Second Brain & Digital Marketing
records.description: Explore real systems for productivity, Notion, AI tools, and student life. Built by a 20-year-old who learns in public — one post at a time.

records.name: Gainflow: Gym Workout Tracker
records.tagline: Gainflow AI analyzes users' exercise technique
records.description: Gainflow uses AI video analysis to provide reports on your exercise technique. Unlike standard trackers, it offers form correction and generates personalized training plans. It combines workout logging with automated technical feedback to improve safety and precision.

records.name: TravelPhotographic — Photo Licensing
records.tagline: #travel #photography
records.description: TravelPhotographic.com is a curated collection of travel photography captured across cities, cultures, and landscapes around the world. Every image on this platform represents a real moment — photographed during journeys through historic streets, modern skylines, iconic landmarks, and quiet corners of the world that often go unnoticed. Its goal is to share authentic visual stories from global destinations while making high-quality travel imagery accessible for creative and professional use.

records.name: Food Roulette
records.tagline: Spin a wheel, get your lunch or dinner in 10 seconds
records.description: Can't decide what to eat? Food Roulette solves it in 2 spins. Step 1: Spin the cuisine wheel (Korean, Italian, Mexican, Japanese, Indian, Mediterranean, American + more) Step 2: Spin the dish wheel — get your exact meal 80+ dishes across 11 cuisines. Filter by vibe, exclude dishes you're tired of, spin again anytime. Built this because I was spending 20+ minutes every day just trying to figure out what to eat for lunch. Now it takes 10 seconds. → https://allaboutworld.xyz

records.name: Routine Checker
records.tagline: Daily routine tracker. One tap at a time.
records.description: Routine Checker is a daily routine tracker that puts your whole day in one place: morning, afternoon, evening, workout, and anytime. No overwhelming to‑do lists you plan sections, tap to complete tasks, and build streaks. It’s built to be simple and fast so you actually stick to the plan. Free to try, then subscribe. iOS only for now.

records.name: Truth or Dare: Fun Game Night
records.tagline: party game designed for adults, couples, and friends.
records.description: Choose or Dare is the ultimate party game designed for adults, couples, and groups of friends. This isn't just any truth or dare game—it's powered by a fun and exciting finger chooser mechanic that adds a fresh twist to every round.

records.name: FlashGenius
records.tagline: Paste your notes → get AI flashcards in 10 seconds.
records.description: FlashGenius turns any lecture notes, textbook content, or study material into 6 beautiful, color-coded flashcards — instantly. FEATURES: - AI generates 6 flashcards from any notes - Beautiful flip card animations - Works for ANY subject PERFECT FOR: - College & university students - High school exam prep - Last-minute revision - Anyone who wants to study smarter, not harder WHAT YOU GET: - Instant access to the web app - No installation needed - Lifetime access

records.name: LYD - Lidarr YouTube Downloader
records.tagline: The missing bridge between YouTube and Lidarr
records.description: Seamlessly bridge Lidarr and YouTube. Automatically fetch missing albums, download them as fully tagged MP3s, and trigger instant Lidarr imports to complete your music library.

records.name: Bavishyavani.in Marriage Age Calculator
records.tagline: A Tool which predicts your Age of Marriage Accurately
records.description: Use our free Marriage Age Calculator to predict when you may get married based on astrology. Enter your birth details and get instant marriage prediction online.

records.name: SmartCV AI
records.tagline: Create a professional CV and cover letter with AI in minutes
records.description: SmartCV AI is an AI-powered platform that helps you create a professional CV, generate cover letters and improve your job applications in minutes. Save time and increase your chances of getting hired.

records.name: Cloud Desk
records.tagline: Your browser is now your desktop
records.description: CloudDesk.App turns your browser into a customizable workspace. Drag and drop widgets.Notes, tasks, clocks, GitHub repos, timers onto an infinite canvas. Pick from 20+ themes or design your own. Sign in with Google and your setup syncs everywhere. No install, no friction. Just open and make it yours. Built for devs and creators who want a homepage that actually works.

records.name: FutureChamp
records.tagline: Your kid's personal trainer between practices. Free.
records.description: Free adaptive training app for youth athletes ages 6-17. Kids take a 5-test fitness baseline, get their percentile vs other kids their age, and receive personalized workouts calibrated to their level. 8 sports with position-specific training, 15 min/day, zero equipment. Built-in overtraining prevention, pain responsive exercise modification, and game schedule integration. Coach Report Card lets parents share fitness data with coaches. Built by a sports dad. No ads, no paywall. COPPA compliant.

records.name: aimag.me
records.tagline: Self-reflection through tarot & AI
records.description: aimag.me is an AI tarot reading platform that combines ancient symbolism with modern psychology. Get free daily card readings with AI interpretations grounded in Jungian archetypes — no mysticism, just meaningful self-reflection. Available in 6 languages with 78 card meanings, 23 spreads, and 3 AI mentor styles.

records.name: OpenHive
records.tagline: Open-source Slack alternative you can self-host in minutes
records.description: OpenHive is a fully open-source team messaging platform — think Slack, but self-hosted and free. Built with Next.js, Supabase and LiveKit. Real-time channels, DMs, threaded replies, video/audio calls with screen sharing, file uploads, @mentions, slash commands, webhooks, bots, and a fully responsive UI. Clone, run npm run dev, and the setup wizard auto-provisions your database (23+ tables with RLS). No vendor lock-in. Try it: openhivedemo.com — MIT licensed, contributors welcome!

records.name: Luecentra
records.tagline: AI Assistant for Interviews in real time
records.description: Check out the bypass community on Discord, and try out the most affordable and best quality AI assistant for interviews on the market right now.

records.name: NotebookLM Chunker
records.tagline: Chunk PDFs into NotebookLM sources with bulk Studio queue
records.description: I upload long documents to NotebookLM a lot, but a 500-page PDF as a single source gives shallow results. This tool splits it at headings and uploads each part separately, so the reports and quizzes actually go deep into each section. The main thing it solves is the quota problem. You can queue 170 Studio jobs, get blocked at job 40, come back tomorrow and retry. Pick a PDF, set chunk size, skip the preface if you want, review everything, sync, and manage the queue from one screen.

records.name: SecurityTime
records.tagline: AI-powered security guard management software
records.description: SecurityTime is AI-powered security guard management software built specifically for Australian security companies. Manage guard rostering, GPS clock-in and clock-out, digital timesheets, compliance tracking, incident reporting and payroll exports in one platform. SecurityTime also includes an AI Voice Call Agent that automatically calls guards who are late for shifts and reminds staff about expiring licences or compliance documents.

records.name: Ghost
records.tagline: Redact PII from documents without uploading a single file
records.description: Redaction, ROPA, and DSARs unified in a single tool built for the people handling the tasks. AI-powered PII redaction and Records of Processing Activities for DPOs, legal, HR, and medical teams. 100% client-side — nothing leaves your browser.

records.name: Showlancer
records.tagline: Build your personal portfolio website in minutes
records.description: Showlancer is a modern portfolio builder that helps creators, developers, designers, students, and freelancers create a professional portfolio website in minutes. Showcase your projects, skills, certificates, and achievements using clean templates and an easy editor. Showlancer also includes an AI assistant that gives personalized career guidance based on your portfolio content.

records.name: CodekHub
records.tagline: Match with developers and build projects together
records.description: Codekhub is a platform designed to help developers find collaborators and build projects together. Developers can discover projects, connect with other developers, create teams, manage tasks, chat, and collaborate in dedicated workspaces. The goal is to make it easier for developers to turn ideas into real projects by finding the right people to build with.

records.name: Aware
records.tagline: Menu bar app: keeps Mac awake via face detection
records.description: A macOS menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake by detecting your presence with the FaceTime camera. Local & private — No networking, telemetry, third-party dependencies, or even temp-directory writes; captured frames are processed in memory and discarded immediately. Hardware-accelerated — Uses Vision on Apple Silicon; face detection runs on GPU or Apple Neural Engine, not CPU. Smart presence detection — Skips camera checks when you've used the keyboard or mouse in the last 30 seconds.
